zh.title: VCamdroid：把旧 Android 手机变成 Windows 摄像头
zh.summary: 在 Android 手机上采集并编码视频，再通过 USB/ADB 或同一局域网传给 Windows 客户端，注册为可被视频应用识别的虚拟摄像头。
zh.outcome: 复用闲置 Android 手机的摄像头，作为 Windows 10/11 的视频输入。
applicable_devices: 上游前提列出 Android 7.0 或更高版本的手机，以及 Windows 10 或 11 电脑。
USB 路线需要可用数据线、ADB 与手机端 USB 调试授权；Wi-Fi 路线要求手机和电脑位于可互通的同一网络。
具体手机的 Camera2、硬件编码、分辨率和稳定性仍需逐机验证。
prerequisites: Windows 端需要管理员权限运行 install.bat，以注册 Softcam DirectShow 过滤器。
手机端需要安装 APK；USB 路线还要启用开发者选项和 USB 调试。
Wi-Fi 路线可能需要放行 Windows 防火墙；应先确认网络隔离与隐私边界。
stop_conditions: 不能确认电脑是受支持的 Windows 版本，或无法接受安装并注册第三方虚拟摄像头驱动时停止。
ADB 设备始终不可见、手机不支持所需编码路径，或 Wi-Fi 被 AP isolation / 防火墙阻断时先排障，不把失败解释为已兼容。
上游 README 没有给出完整卸载/回滚流程；在无法确认驱动移除办法的电脑上不要继续安装。
risks: USB 调试会授予已确认电脑 ADB 权限；只在自己控制的电脑上授权，并在结束后撤销不再需要的授权。
Wi-Fi 视频流和防火墙放行会扩大本机网络暴露面；不要在不可信网络上默认开放。
性能、延迟、音频、耗电和长期稳定性没有经过 KitAgain 实机测试。
recovery: 优先在非主力电脑和备用手机上试用，并先记录 Windows 端注册的组件与手机端权限。
出现问题时先停止客户端、断开 ADB/网络连接并撤销手机授权；驱动移除必须以当前上游说明或 Windows 组件记录为准。
good_fit: 手里已有 Android 7+ 备用机和可管理的 Windows 10/11 电脑。
愿意先用 USB 路线验证，再决定是否开放 Wi-Fi 路线。
not_fit: 需要 macOS/Linux 摄像头方案、不能取得 Windows 管理员权限，或不能接受 USB 调试。
需要已证明的跨设备低延迟、音频或长期稳定性保证。

en.title: VCamdroid: turn an old Android phone into a Windows webcam
en.summary: Capture and encode video on an Android phone, send it to a Windows client over USB/ADB or the same local network, and expose it as a virtual webcam to video applications.
en.outcome: Reuse a spare Android phone camera as a video input for Windows 10 or 11.
applicable_devices: The upstream prerequisites name phones on Android 7.0 or later and PCs on Windows 10 or 11.
USB needs a data cable, ADB, and phone-side USB-debugging authorization; Wi-Fi needs a mutually reachable local network.
Camera2 behavior, hardware encoding, resolution, and stability still require per-phone verification.
prerequisites: The Windows install.bat needs administrator rights to register the Softcam DirectShow filter.
The APK must be installed on the phone; the USB route also requires Developer Options and USB debugging.
The Wi-Fi route may need a Windows Firewall rule; check network isolation and privacy boundaries first.
stop_conditions: Stop if the PC is not on a stated Windows version or if installing and registering a third-party virtual-camera filter is unacceptable.
If ADB never sees the device, the phone lacks the required encoding path, or AP isolation/firewall blocks Wi-Fi, troubleshoot first; do not convert failure into a compatibility claim.
The reviewed README does not document a complete uninstall/rollback procedure. Do not install on a PC where the filter-removal path cannot be established.
risks: USB debugging grants ADB access to an approved computer. Authorize only a computer you control and revoke access when it is no longer needed.
A Wi-Fi video stream and firewall allowance increase local-network exposure; do not leave them open by default on an untrusted network.
KitAgain has not tested performance, latency, audio, battery use, or long-term stability.
recovery: Prefer a non-primary PC and spare phone, recording the registered Windows component and phone permissions before the trial.
On failure, stop the clients, disconnect ADB/network access, and revoke phone authorization. Remove the filter only using current upstream instructions or verified Windows component records.
good_fit: You already own a spare Android 7+ phone and administer a Windows 10/11 PC.
You can validate USB first before deciding whether to enable Wi-Fi.
not_fit: You need a macOS/Linux route, lack Windows administrator rights, or cannot accept USB debugging.
You need proven cross-device latency, audio, or long-term reliability guarantees.

zh.title: freeMarkable：为 reMarkable 安装 XOVI 与第三方应用入口
zh.summary: 通过电脑端 Python GUI 和 reMarkable 的 SSH/USB 网络连接安装 XOVI、AppLoad，并可选集成 KOReader；这是修改设备软件栈的工具，不是普通文档同步应用。
zh.outcome: 在上游列出的 reMarkable 设备上获得第三方应用框架与启动入口。
applicable_devices: 上游 README 列出 reMarkable 1（armv6l）、reMarkable 2（armv7l/armhf）和 reMarkable Paper Pro（aarch64/arm64）。
支持范围是上游作者声明；KitAgain 没有在这些设备上独立安装或验证。
reMarkable 与 Kindle 不是同一平台；下方墨水屏专题仅作相邻决策入口，不能互换安装步骤。
prerequisites: 电脑需要 Python 3.10 或更高版本、互联网连接，以及可运行项目启动脚本的 Windows/Linux 环境；README 也声称跨平台支持。
设备需要启用 SSH，并通过 USB 或 Wi-Fi 连接；上游明确建议只用 USB，Wi-Fi 不推荐。
安装前确认设备电量充足、架构检测结果正确，并能读回自动生成的备份。
stop_conditions: 设备型号或 CPU 架构与上游表不一致，SSH 不可用，或电脑无法建立稳定 USB 网络连接时停止。
安装器没有成功创建可读备份、无法说明恢复位置，或用户不能接受修改系统组件时停止。
不要把上游“全设备支持”“可靠安装”等作者陈述当作 KitAgain 的兼容或成功保证。
risks: 该路线安装 XOVI、AppLoad、可选 KOReader 和系统服务，会修改设备软件环境。
上游声明自动备份、恢复和卸载能力，但本页没有独立验证这些恢复步骤。
固件升级、架构变化、Xochitl/USB 连接异常和第三方组件更新都可能改变当前行为。
recovery: 开始前保存安装器创建的备份、记录设备软件版本和连接方式，并确认备份可访问。
安装后若主应用或 USB 连接异常，先按上游已记录的连接排障；若无法确认恢复路径，不继续叠加安装。
good_fit: 拥有上游列出的 reMarkable 型号，并愿意维护 SSH、Python 与第三方应用框架。
需要 XOVI/AppLoad 或 KOReader 入口，且能承担系统修改与恢复核对。
not_fit: 只想同步文档、不能启用 SSH，或不能保留并验证备份。
需要厂商支持不变、零维护或已由 KitAgain 证明的兼容性。

en.title: freeMarkable: install XOVI and a third-party app entry on reMarkable
en.summary: Use a desktop Python GUI plus the reMarkable SSH/USB-network connection to install XOVI and AppLoad, with optional KOReader integration. This changes the device software stack; it is not a normal document-sync app.
en.outcome: Add a third-party application framework and launcher entry to reMarkable devices listed upstream.
applicable_devices: The upstream README lists reMarkable 1 (armv6l), reMarkable 2 (armv7l/armhf), and reMarkable Paper Pro (aarch64/arm64).
That scope is an upstream author claim; KitAgain has not independently installed or verified the toolkit on those devices.
reMarkable and Kindle are different platforms. The linked e-ink guide is adjacent decision context, not interchangeable installation guidance.
prerequisites: The computer needs Python 3.10 or later, internet access, and a Windows/Linux environment that can run the project launchers; the README also claims cross-platform support.
The device needs SSH plus USB or Wi-Fi connectivity. Upstream explicitly recommends USB and does not recommend Wi-Fi for installation.
Confirm adequate charge, the detected architecture, and a readable installer-created backup before modification.
stop_conditions: Stop when the model or CPU architecture differs from the upstream table, SSH is unavailable, or a stable USB-network connection cannot be established.
Stop when the installer did not create a readable backup, the restore location is unclear, or system modification is unacceptable.
Do not turn upstream phrases such as all-device support or reliable installation into a KitAgain compatibility or success guarantee.
risks: The route installs XOVI, AppLoad, optional KOReader, and system services, changing the device software environment.
Upstream claims automatic backup, restore, and uninstall features; this page has not independently verified those recovery steps.
Firmware updates, architecture changes, Xochitl/USB connection faults, and third-party component updates can change behavior.
recovery: Before starting, retain the installer backup, record the device software version and connection method, and confirm the backup is accessible.
If the main application or USB connection fails after installation, use the documented upstream connection troubleshooting first. Do not stack more changes while recovery is unclear.
good_fit: You own an upstream-listed reMarkable and are prepared to maintain SSH, Python, and a third-party app framework.
You need XOVI/AppLoad or KOReader access and can manage system changes and recovery checks.
not_fit: You only need document sync, cannot enable SSH, or cannot retain and verify a backup.
You require unchanged vendor support, zero maintenance, or compatibility independently proven by KitAgain.

zh.title: HK1 Box：先外置启动，再决定是否写入 Armbian
zh.summary: 把上游支持表中的 HK1 Box 作为 S905X3 电视盒路线核对，先从 USB/TF 启动并验证设备树、网络、存储和散热，再决定是否写入 eMMC。
zh.outcome: 在准确板型匹配时，把闲置电视盒作为 Debian/Ubuntu 兼容的小服务器。
applicable_devices: ophub 支持表列出的 HK1 Box / Amlogic S905X3 路线。
需要逐机核对主板、内存、网卡、存储和 meson-sm1-hk1box-vontar-x3 设备树；同名外壳不能证明一致。
特定 issue 涉及亚克力风扇版的 LED 与风扇 GPIO，不能外推到所有 HK1 Box。
prerequisites: 保存原厂 Android 镜像和启动分区，并准备与准确硬件相符的恢复资料。
先用 USB 或 TF 卡启动，分别验证启动、网络、存储、显示、重启和温度。
明确要运行的服务、供电和散热条件；不要仅因能启动就直接写 eMMC。
stop_conditions: SoC、主板丝印、网卡/存储芯片或设备树无法匹配时停止。
外置启动不稳定、网络或存储缺失、风扇不转或温度异常时停止。
没有原厂备份、恢复镜像或可执行救砖路径时，不写入 eMMC。
risks: 错误设备树可能导致无显示、无网、存储不可见或无法启动。
写入 eMMC 会替换原系统，失败可能需要恢复分区或刷回原厂镜像。
KitAgain 未实测功耗、性能、DRM、散热或长期稳定性。
recovery: 把外置介质启动作为第一道回退；在外置启动未稳定前保持 eMMC 不变。
若已写入 eMMC，只使用与准确板型匹配的上游备份/恢复资料；无法确认时停止继续写入。
good_fit: 手里已有可识别为 S905X3 路线的 HK1 Box，并愿意先做非破坏性外置启动。
需要 Docker、文件服务、Home Assistant 或轻量网络服务，并能维护 Linux 主机。
not_fit: 同名盒子但板型/网卡/存储未知，或没有原厂备份。
需要即插即用媒体认证、已证明性能或零维护设备。

en.title: HK1 Box: boot externally before deciding on Armbian eMMC installation
en.summary: Treat the HK1 Box in the upstream matrix as an S905X3 TV-box route: boot from USB or microSD, verify the device tree, network, storage, and thermals, then decide whether eMMC installation is justified.
en.outcome: When the exact board matches, reuse an idle TV box as a small Debian/Ubuntu-compatible server.
applicable_devices: The HK1 Box / Amlogic S905X3 route listed in the ophub support table.
Match the board, memory, network, storage, and meson-sm1-hk1box-vontar-x3 device tree on the actual unit; a shared enclosure name is not enough.
The linked issue discusses LED and fan GPIO on a particular acrylic fan variant and cannot be generalized to every HK1 Box.
prerequisites: Preserve the stock Android image and boot partitions, plus recovery material for the exact hardware.
Boot from USB or microSD first and test boot, networking, storage, display, reboot, and temperature separately.
Define the intended service, power, and cooling conditions. A successful boot alone is not a reason to write eMMC.
stop_conditions: Stop when the SoC, board marking, network/storage chip, or device tree cannot be matched.
Stop on unstable external boot, missing network/storage, a stopped fan, or unsafe temperature.
Do not write eMMC without a stock backup, recovery image, and executable rescue path.
risks: A wrong device tree can remove display, networking, storage visibility, or boot.
Writing eMMC replaces the stock system; failure may require partition restoration or reflashing the factory image.
KitAgain has not tested power use, performance, DRM, thermals, or long-term stability.
recovery: Use removable-media boot as the first rollback boundary and leave eMMC unchanged until external boot is stable.
After eMMC installation, use only backup/restore material matched to the exact board; stop writing when that match is unclear.
good_fit: You already own an HK1 Box that can be identified on the S905X3 route and will validate it non-destructively first.
You need Docker, file services, Home Assistant, or light network services and can maintain a Linux host.
not_fit: The same-name box has unknown board/network/storage hardware or no stock backup.
You need plug-and-play media certification, proven performance, or a zero-maintenance appliance.
